DIG-01.avoid: Changing each of several equal prices requires compensating once per item.
DIG-01.check: Estimate first, then check the exact place values.

DIG-02.avoid: A PIN may allow a leading zero; a three-digit number cannot.
DIG-02.check: Test zero, repeated digits and the last-digit condition separately.

DIG-03.avoid: Counting labels containing a digit is different from counting copies of that digit.
DIG-03.check: Check a repeated-digit label and both endpoints.

DIG-04.avoid: Repeated blocks such as ABAB need not be palindromes.
DIG-04.check: Read the result backwards and check its length.

DIG-05.avoid: A letter in a digit position is not a multiplication sign.
DIG-05.check: Substitute every digit and check all carries and distinctness conditions.

DIV-01.avoid: The number of divisors is different from their sum.
DIV-01.check: List factor pairs for a smaller example, including 1 and the number.

DIV-02.avoid: Different starting times need offsets as well as a common period.
DIV-02.check: Check both schedules and show there is no earlier valid meeting.

DIV-03.avoid: Leftovers and spaces needed to finish a group are different quantities.
DIV-03.check: Rebuild divisor × quotient + remainder; the remainder is smaller than the divisor.

DIV-04.avoid: Passing an invariant test does not prove a target can be reached.
DIV-04.check: Check the invariant for every legal move; construct a route when claiming possibility.

DIV-05.strategy: Reduce a position by a period
DIV-05.avoid: A repeated value without a repeated state may not start a true cycle.
DIV-05.check: Label the first position and test a position exactly divisible by the period.

FRAC-01.avoid: A fraction of the remainder has a new base.
FRAC-01.check: Account for everything removed and everything remaining.

FRAC-02.avoid: A ratio gives relative parts, not the total number of items.
FRAC-02.check: Reconstruct both quantities and their total or difference.

FRAC-03.avoid: Equal percentage increases and decreases do not cancel.
FRAC-03.check: Name the base of each percentage and check the direction of change.

FRAC-04.avoid: Averaging fractions is unsafe when the group sizes differ.
FRAC-04.check: Find actual counts first; the combined fraction must use the combined whole.

RATE-01.strategy: Use common units and count intervals
RATE-01.avoid: Five events can have four gaps, unless the question includes a gap before the first.
RATE-01.check: Draw the first and last event and label the units.

RATE-02.avoid: Completion times cannot be added as if they were rates.
RATE-02.check: Check the work completed in the proposed time.

RATE-03.avoid: A mean of speeds is not usually the whole-journey average.
RATE-03.check: Add all distances and all times, including stops.

RATE-04.avoid: Chasing in the same direction uses a speed difference.
RATE-04.check: Check both travellers occupy the same position at the proposed time.

ALG-01.avoid: The unknown must describe one specific quantity with units.
ALG-01.check: Substitute into the original story, not only the rearranged equation.

ALG-02.avoid: Halving the total alone ignores the extra part.
ALG-02.check: Check both the sum and the gap.

ALG-03.check: Use your values to rebuild both collections.

ALG-04.avoid: Undoing operations in the original order generally fails.

ALG-05.avoid: A transfer changes both piles; adding from outside changes only one.
ALG-05.check: Check the total stays fixed during a transfer and both final piles meet the condition.

SEQ-01.avoid: A constant difference is needed for an arithmetic-sequence shortcut.
SEQ-01.check: Check the first, second and last terms and the number of gaps.

SEQ-02.avoid: Repeated addition does not justify a doubling formula.
SEQ-02.check: Check the first few terms against the actual growth rule.

SEQ-03.avoid: A recurrence must cover all possible last moves without overlap.
SEQ-03.check: State starting cases and compare against a complete small list.

SEQ-04.avoid: A repeated output alone may hide a different next move.
SEQ-04.check: Record every part needed to determine the next state.

COUNT-01.avoid: An unordered pair must not be counted again backwards.
COUNT-01.check: Name an ordering rule and explain why no case is missing.

COUNT-02.avoid: Dividing by a factorial fails when outcomes have different numbers of descriptions.
COUNT-02.check: Explain exactly how many times each outcome was counted.

COUNT-03.avoid: A neighbouring block can have more than one internal order.
COUNT-03.check: Check the neighbours and the internal order separately.

COUNT-04.avoid: The unwanted cases must be removed exactly once.
COUNT-04.check: Draw the whole set, overlap and outside region.

COUNT-05.avoid: A shared vertex or handshake may contribute more than once.
COUNT-05.check: Explain each object's contribution to both totals.

COUNT-06.avoid: Cases that overlap or miss outcomes cannot be added safely.
COUNT-06.check: Give every possible outcome one and only one case.

LOGIC-01.avoid: The opposite of all is not none: one counterexample suffices.
LOGIC-01.check: Check the truth of the entire statement in each case.

LOGIC-02.avoid: Satisfying the first clue is not enough.
LOGIC-02.check: Test every original condition, including distinctness and integer restrictions.

LOGIC-03.avoid: Only compare totals that count the same entries.
LOGIC-03.check: Mark which cells each total includes.

LOGIC-04.avoid: One working example does not prove uniqueness.
LOGIC-04.check: Find a solution, then explain why all other cases fail.

GEO-01.avoid: Area and perimeter measure different things.
GEO-01.check: Trace the outside once; remove shared interior edges twice from separate perimeters.

GEO-02.avoid: A sloping side is not a perpendicular height.
GEO-02.check: Use another partition or subtract from the surrounding shape.

GEO-03.avoid: An unscaled drawing is not a measurement.
GEO-03.check: Name the geometric fact behind each angle or shape claim.

GEO-04.avoid: Matching outlines may hide different labels or colours.
GEO-04.check: Track a labelled point, orientation and colours through the transformation.

GEO-05.strategy: Prove a bound and attain it
GEO-05.avoid: The best example found so far is not necessarily the best possible.
GEO-05.check: Explain why nothing can beat the bound, then build a case that reaches it.

SOLID-01.avoid: Visible cubes are not necessarily all the cubes.
SOLID-01.check: Count by a second layer direction or subtract missing blocks from a full cuboid.

SOLID-02.avoid: A hollow or partly painted solid does not follow the full-cube shortcut.
SOLID-02.check: Check which faces were painted and classify corners, edges and face interiors.

SOLID-03.avoid: Volume counts cubes; surface area counts faces; edges count joins.
SOLID-03.check: Fold the net mentally and label opposite faces and matching lengths.

SPATIAL-01.avoid: Adding local route totals assumes the allowed last-step cases are disjoint.
SPATIAL-01.check: Check the starting count and every blocked point or forbidden direction.

SPATIAL-02.avoid: Grid lines and grid cells have different counts.
SPATIAL-02.check: Label the origin, direction and endpoints before counting.

SPATIAL-03.avoid: Matching area or colour counts is necessary but may not be sufficient.
SPATIAL-03.check: Test the invariant, then construct a tiling if claiming one exists.

SPATIAL-04.avoid: Visiting every vertex differs from using every edge.
SPATIAL-04.check: Track visited vertices or used edges according to the actual rule.

DATA-01.avoid: Different totals need not be equally likely.
DATA-01.check: List elementary outcomes and check probabilities sum to one.

DATA-02.avoid: Averaging two means requires equal group sizes.
DATA-02.check: Rebuild the combined total and count.

DATA-03.avoid: Ticks need not count by one or start at zero.
DATA-03.check: Read labels, units and tick intervals before comparing values.
